findings.text: 面向已有Molio知识库的DSH用户，在对话中查库、搜索并读取原文以支持研究写作。
[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02) 核实tools注册→库解析→GET请求→daemon磁盘读取→返回。
检查目标组件注册/HTTP/库解析/读取工具，并定向读同仓daemon文件路由和磁盘读取；未全面审计Molio平台或远程部署。
真实DSH子插件，bundle patch注册molio-kb；源码范围限定该组件，daemon仅作为必要共享依赖核查。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 已有daemon和插件磁盘 | 配置地址/profile并核库 | 时间未测 |
| 持续 | daemon资源和读文token | 资料维护与引用复核 | 总模型费用未知 |
| 失败恢复 | 重试请求 | 查服务/库id/文件大小 | 恢复耗时未测 |
| 退出 | 原库保留 | 移除插件回Molio界面 | 子插件无写回数据迁移 |
[Q04](#research-q04) 已有本地daemon者可显式库id试读已知原文；错库、路径或内容不符时停止据此回答并回Molio/原文件。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 原文进入对话 | GET到磁盘原文完整链 | 引用正确率和节时 |
| 错误可理解 | 重名/过大/二进制分支 | 真实宿主取消/服务异常表现 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 复用读取内核和明确歧义错误易维护；[Q03](#research-q03)应区分只读适配、默认库状态和daemon认证责任。
[Q02](#research-q02) 复用CLI读取语义并把库id、原文、类型及错误带回DSH，减少人工搬运资料的接线。
[Q03](#research-q03) 只读子插件不保证整个daemon权限安全；默认active库可随用户操作改变，多次工具调用不是固定资料快照。
[Q04](#research-q04) 推导一轮检索绑定明确库id的未验证策略，对照切库/同名库的错库率与核对成本；无改善则推翻。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)：以已有CLI/MCP为参照，移植适配新颖25%、机制25%；只读客户端模式可迁移50%；省配置仅局部简化25%，不计daemon原创。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)与[Q04](#research-q04)支持工作流25%9、交付25%8：减少Molio到DSH的搬运，仍交付相同原文；触达25%5是已有Molio用户获得宿主入口，仍需daemon与库。economics取0，既有本地daemon和读原文是前提，没有新增计价、资源组织或服务方式；搬运便利归工作流，不再重复计经济贡献。

recommendation.reason: 已有本地 Molio daemon 和知识库的 DSH 用户可指定明确库 id 试读一篇已知原文。相比在界面搜索后手动复制，插件把只读检索接入对话，但问答质量和节时尚未实测。若库、路径或内容与预期不符，用户应停止据此回答并回到 Molio 界面或原文件。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)组件README:3-11说明资料问答任务/人群/原文判据，50%；无需求强度直接证据，不到75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)接口移植与GET桥接只是局部便利25%；已有CLI可完成，不到实质流程50%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)追到实际磁盘读取及错误分支50%；无运行测试不到75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)已有本地daemon前提下只读、显式库和回原界面负担较轻75%；引用复核与daemon边界仍需用户处理，不到100%。

\n\n---\n\nWhat you've accumulated isn't one kind of thing: experience and methods scattered across notes, documents, and chat logs — and also whole books, PDFs full of figures, piles of industry material. Most of it sits in a form AI can't read, so every conversation starts from zero.\n\nMolio turns all of it into a **personal knowledge base** that AI can read and use: Claude Code, Codex, and other agents enter your knowledge space, work on top of everything you've accumulated — researching, writing, answering, analyzing — and write their results back as Markdown, so the base grows thicker with every task. Everything runs on your machine, never through a third-party server.\n\nStarting from zero? The [resource library](https://molio.cn/resources.html) ships ready-made knowledge bases that keep growing — import one and start asking.\n\n
\n\n[](https://molio.cn/videos/zizhitongjian-overview-v2.mp4)\n\n**▶ Click to watch the demo** — one book, one knowledge universe: 1,362 years of history from the *Zizhi Tongjian*, processed by Molio into an AI-explorable knowledge base\n\n
\n\n### 🔁 How It Works\n\n**01 · Collect & Process — scattered fragments, or a whole book, all become a callable knowledge base**\n\nInput isn't limited by format: clip pages with one click via the [Web Clipper](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pjdacbbkjpegfkogoieejajljplngbik), open your Obsidian vault directly, or batch-import local documents. Scanned PDFs and Word / PPT / Excel files go through the bundled docling for layout analysis, OCR, and table reconstruction; images are read by OCR; million-word books run through a chunked preprocessing and digest pipeline with resumable progress. What lands on disk is plain Markdown — zero migration, no lock-in.\n\nThe Wiki engine then extracts entities and concepts from that unified Markdown layer, weaving dense cross-links and layered indexes — data becomes a foundation only after it's processed.\n\n**02 · Work & Task — agents run on your data**\n\nClaude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code — agents work inside your knowledge space, researching, writing, answering, and analyzing. What they see is no blank slate, but everything you've accumulated. Pick an agent in a unified GUI with streaming output; scan a QR code to chat with your base from your phone via WeChat.\n\n**03 · Reflow & Deposit — the base grows thicker with use**\n\nEvery task's output is written back as Markdown — a reusable, long-term asset. The knowledge graph keeps growing, so the next task starts from higher ground. Ready to publish? Typeset with doocs/md and distribute to 30+ platforms in one click.\n\n### 📥 Supported Inputs\n\n| Input | What happens |\n|-------|--------------|\n| Markdown / TXT / HTML / CSV and other text | Read as-is — the default shape of a knowledge base |\n| PDF | Layout analysis + OCR + table reconstruction → Markdown |\n| Word / PPT / Excel | Same pipeline, heading hierarchy and tables preserved |\n| Images (PNG / JPG / TIFF) | OCR text extraction |\n| Web pages | One-click clip, or article extraction for WeChat posts |\n| Obsidian vault | Opened in place — original files are read-only |\n| Million-word books | Chunked preprocessing + digest pipeline, resumable |\n\n> PDF and Office conversion is handled by the bundled docling skill. \n\n## 🚀 Quick Start\n\n### Installation\n\nDownload the latest release from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/zhuzhaoyun/Molio/releases):\n\n- **Windows**: `Molio-Setup-x.x.x.exe`\n- **macOS**: `Molio-x.x.x.dmg`\n\nInstall and launch. On first run, you'll be guided to configure an AI runtime CLI (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Gemini).\n\n### 🐳 Docker / NAS Deployment (self-hosted)\n\nRun Molio as a self-hosted web service on a NAS or server. A single container bundles the daemon, web UI, and Claude Code CLI, and works on both `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` — Synology, QNAP, TerraMaster, TrueNAS, Unraid, and most other NAS devices.\n\n> **⚠️ How this differs from the desktop app (read before deploying)**\n>\n> - **Browser access only — there is no desktop client for this mode.** The Electron desktop app only ever talks to the daemon it launches locally (`localhost`); it **cannot** connect to a container running on a remote NAS/server.\n> - **The daemon runs inside the container and can only read/write directories mounted into it.** The desktop workflow of \"pick any local folder as a knowledge base via a folder picker\" does not apply here — the browser has no folder picker, so when you add a knowledge base you **type a container-internal path** (e.g. `/vaults/your-folder`, not the NAS host path).\n> - To expose folders as knowledge bases, mount them under `/vaults` in `docker-compose.yml` `volumes`. Your data still stays entirely yours (on your NAS) — only the access model changes, from \"desktop app\" to \"browser + mounted volumes\".\n\n**One-click install** (requires Docker + Docker Compose v2):\n\n```bash\n# China (recommended)\ncurl -fsSL https://molio-releases.oss-cn-guangzhou.aliyuncs.com/script/install.sh | bash\n# Overseas\ncurl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhuzhaoyun/Molio/main/install.sh | bash\n# Offline (clone the repo first, then run the bundled script)\nbash install.sh\n```\n\nThe script asks for your knowledge-base directory and port, then pulls the image and starts the service. When it finishes, open `http://:3100`, then go to **Settings → Runtimes** to configure your AI model and API key. On first boot Molio **auto-creates a default knowledge base** on the mounted directory, so you land straight inside — no manual setup.\n\n**Manual install** (if you prefer plain `docker compose`):\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/zhuzhaoyun/Molio.git && cd Molio\ncp .env.example .env # AI model is configured later in the web UI\ndocker compose up -d # then open http://:3100\n```\n\n**Everyday commands** (run inside the install directory, default `~/molio`):\n\n```bash\ndocker compose logs -f # follow logs\ndocker compose restart # restart\ndocker compose pull && docker compose up -d # update to the latest image\ndocker compose down # stop\n```\n\n> Set `MOLIO_VAULT_PATH` in `.env` to mount your existing documents folder into the container (at `/vaults`). See [`install.sh`](install.sh) and [`.env.example`](.env.example) for every option.\n\n### Development (from source)\n\nIf you want to build from source or contribute to development:\n\n**Prerequisites:**\n- **Node.js** >= 22\n- **pnpm** >= 9\n- At least one AI runtime CLI:\n - [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/claude-code)\n - [OpenAI Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex)\n - [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli)\n - [Qwen Code](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code)\n\n```bash\n# Clone the repository\ngit clone https://github.com/zhuzhaoyun/Molio.git\ncd Molio\n\n# Install dependencies\npnpm install\n\n# Start development environment (daemon + web)\npnpm dev\n\n# Or start individually\npnpm dev:daemon # Backend only (port 3100)\npnpm dev:web # Frontend only (port 5173)\n```\n\n**Desktop Build:**\n\n```bash\n# One-click build + generate unpacked version\npnpm desktop:run\n\n# Or full packaging as installer\npnpm package\n\n# Generate unpacked directory only (no installer)\npnpm package:dir\n```\n\n**Testing:**\n\n```bash\npnpm test # Run all tests (node:test)\npnpm typecheck # Type checking\npnpm build # Build all packages\npnpm test:e2e # E2E tests (requires pnpm dev running)\n```\n\n### 🔌 MCP server & Pi package\n\nMolio's knowledge base is also available as a read-only MCP server, so Claude Code, Cursor, Pi, and any MCP-compatible agent can search and read your local vaults mid-conversation:\n\n```bash\nnpx -y @molio/cli mcp # stdio MCP server, 7 read-only tools\nclaude mcp add molio -- npx -y @molio/cli mcp # register it in Claude Code\npi install npm:@molio/cli # Pi: auto-registers the server + a `molio-kb` skill\n```\n\nAny other MCP client:\n\n```json\n{\n \"mcpServers\": {\n \"molio\": { \"command\": \"npx\", \"args\": [\"-y\", \"@molio/cli\", \"mcp\"] }\n }\n}\n```\n\nTools: `molio_status`, `kb_vaults`, `kb_tree`, `kb_read`, `kb_search`, `kb_ask_start`, `kb_ask_poll` — strictly read-only, published to the official MCP Registry as `io.github.zhuzhaoyun/molio`. Requires a running Molio service (desktop app or Docker). Details: [`apps/cli/README.md`](apps/cli/README.md) · [npm: @molio/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@molio/cli)\n\n### 🧩 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin\n\nMolio's knowledge base is also available as a read-only plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), so dsh agents can search and read your local Molio vaults during a conversation:\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin add dsh-plugin-molio\n```\n\nIt exposes 5 read-only tools (`molio_status`, `molio_kb_vaults`, `molio_kb_tree`, `molio_kb_search`, `molio_kb_read`) backed by the local Molio daemon HTTP API. Requires a running Molio service (desktop app or Docker). Details: [`packages/dsh-plugin-molio/README.md`](packages/dsh-plugin-molio/README.md) · [npm: dsh-plugin-molio](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-molio)\n\n## 🏗️ Architecture\n\n```\nMolio/\n├── packages/\n│ └── contracts/ @molio/contracts — Shared type definitions\n├── apps/\n│ ├── daemon/ @molio/daemon — Hono HTTP server (API + SSE)\n│ ├── web/ @molio/web — Vite + React frontend\n│ └── desktop/ @molio/desktop — Electron desktop shell\n└── package.json Monorepo root config\n```\n\n**Tech Stack:**\n- **Frontend:** React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript\n- **Backend:** Hono + Node.js + SQLite (better-sqlite3)\n- **Desktop:** Electron 40 + electron-builder\n- **Build:** pnpm workspace monorepo\n\n## ❓ FAQ\n\n### macOS says the app is \"damaged and can't be opened\"\n\nThis is macOS Gatekeeper's security warning, because Molio is currently **not notarized with Apple** (requires an Apple Developer Program subscription at $99/year). It's not a problem with the app itself. Either:\n\n**Option 1 (recommended)**: Right-click the app → \"Open\" → click \"Open\" in the dialog (first launch only).\n\n**Option 2**: Run in Terminal:\n```bash\nsudo xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Molio.app\n```\n\nAfter that, it opens normally with a double-click.\n\n## 🏢 Custom Services\n\nKeep your core knowledge in your own yard — data processing, consulting, and private deployment on demand. One demo says it all.\n\n**[Learn more →](https://molio.cn/enterprise.html)**\n\n## 🤝 Contributing\n\nContributions are welcome! Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines.\n\n**Key principles:**\n- All changes must go through Pull Request (no direct pushes to `main`)\n- Follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/): `feat(scope): description`\n- Add tests for bug fixes (unit tests for daemon/desktop, E2E for web)\n- Run smoke tests before submitting PRs\n\n## 💬 Community & Support\n\nFile an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/zhuzhaoyun/Molio/issues), or scan the QR code below to join our WeChat community:\n\n\n\n## ❤️ Acknowledgments\n\nMolio is inspired and supported by these excellent open-source projects:\n\n- **[multica](https://github.com/multica-ai/multica)** — Open-source Agent management platform, inspiring Molio's multi-runtime orchestration\n- **[doocs/md](https://github.com/doocs/md)** — WeChat Markdown editor, powering Molio's typesetting engine\n- **[doocs/cose](https://github.com/doocs/cose)** — Multi-platform content distribution extension, powering Molio's publishing capabilities\n- **[WeKnora](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora)** — Tencent's open-source knowledge management platform, providing design philosophy reference\n\nThanks to the authors and communities of these projects!\n\n## 📄 License\n\n[Modified Apache 2.0](LICENSE) — Based on Apache License 2.0 with additional commercial use restrictions.
